title: Kestra 1.3.24 before 1.3.41 contains an insufficient credential expiration vulnerability that allows holders of a…
description: Kestra versions from 1.3.24 up to but not including 1.3.41 have a vulnerability in credential expiration handling. This flaw allows users holding a revoked administrator password to continue authenticating on peer webserver nodes due to a process-local verified-token cache in BasicAuthService. An attacker with a cached token on a peer node can exploit this to overwrite shared administrator credentials via a POST request, potentially locking out the legitimate administrator.
